Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Weather / season: a snowy day — snow falls or lies outside, with frost on any window.
Time of day: early morning — low clean light, long soft shadows.
Hair: her hair tied up in a loose bun or ponytail — same colour and length as the attached image, a few strands loose.
Light direction: dappled light — patches of light with leaf or blind shadow across her.
Outfit: short denim dungarees over a bandeau top, one strap unhooked, canvas sneakers; right now — a sudden rain shower or a splash of water has just soaked her clothes — the damp fabric clings to her body line and darkens in patches, a few wet strands of hair stick to her neck and cheek; the fabric stays opaque, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: standing.
COMPOSITION: a chest-up shot of her face, shoulders and expression; body in side profile, facing the right of the frame, so her own right side is toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly below, looking up at her.
Lens / perspective: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP — her near arm, on the camera side.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand stays outside the frame — her far arm, on the side away from the camera.
PROP: with her own right hand she holds a small clear lanthanum-glass camera lens with a faint violet-green coating glint up beside her face; it is all she holds.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: brows released upward and outward, eyes half closed, breath-out mouth slightly open, whole face loosened.

Framing: a chest-up shot — the bottom edge crosses just below her bust; waist, hips and legs are out of frame.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — lanthanum: a soft silvery-white metal that dulls in air, found in 1839 hiding inside cerium oxide and named from the Greek for 'to lie hidden'; the first of the fifteen lanthanides, which take their name from it; melted into glass as lanthanum oxide it bends light strongly with little colour fringing, the clear glass of fine camera and telescope lenses; alloyed with nickel it soaks up hydrogen like a metal sponge, filling nickel-metal-hydride batteries — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: tall and statuesque with long legs and a full, curvaceous figure — full bust and hips, narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
